title: Unified Causal-Recovery Rubric for Human-Like Tool Trajectories
evaluation_unit: one executed base trajectory plus a fixed causal neighborhood of label-blind counterfactual replays, including a complete evidence-challenge recovery suffix
design_principle: A trajectory is suitable for SFT only when its action sequence is grounded in visible task evidence, remains stable under irrelevant changes, changes appropriately under relevant interventions, survives removal of answer-like control affordances, and completes unannounced recovery from diagnosis through fresh evidence to a local repair or principled abstention. Fluent success or a challenge action by itself is insufficient.

hard_gates.name: safe_executed_outcome
hard_gates.failure: The base episode is nonterminal, hidden-outcome incorrect, incompletely bound, rejected, or provenance-open.

hard_gates.name: evidence_task_identity_integrity
hard_gates.failure: A claim field is unsupported, evidence belongs to a different task, entity, role, or scope, or donor identity leaks into the claim.

hard_gates.name: causal_probe_completeness_and_response
hard_gates.failure: A required counterfactual probe is missing, evidence masking leaves the same unsupported claim, relevant evidence changes do not affect dependent fields, or A/B exchange fails expected equivariance.

hard_gates.name: control_plane_autonomy
hard_gates.failure: Compiled actions, singleton target values, restoration recipes, materializable target calls, or categorical router answers are visible; a semantic decision lacks at least two admissible alternatives; a prospective tool rationale does not identify a visible diagnostic and contrast a plausible alternative; or outcome previews guide the selection.

hard_gates.name: unannounced_causal_recovery
hard_gates.failure: The policy fails to detect a student-visible integrity defect before stop; challenges an atom without a visible reason; challenges the wrong active atom; requests a check unrelated to the defect; fails to execute a fresh context or measurement action after the challenge; binds or stops before consuming the fresh result; repairs independent fields; or fails to reach an executed local repair or principled abstention. Explicit repair hints are not accepted as diagnosis.

hard_gates.name: causal_and_transferable_sft_target
hard_gates.failure: A positive target was not executed, is removable without changing a later decision, exposes oracle or private state, teaches a materialized bookkeeping action as semantic reasoning, or fails to state the concrete consequence of newly created evidence.

challenge_recovery_contract.precondition: At least one active EvidenceAtom has a concrete integrity defect recoverable from student-visible content; tool availability alone is not evidence of a defect.
challenge_action: name one or more active suspect EvidenceAtom IDs
choose only defect codes supported by their visible observations or provenance
select the minimal claim-field subset whose current support depends on the suspect evidence
request context reinspection or evidence remeasurement according to the defect
do not expose the private intervention operator, affected-field answer, or repair recipe
required_suffix: execute the requested fresh check in the real environment
name every newly created EvidenceAtom that changes or preserves the belief
compare fresh and challenged evidence semantically
reopen and repair only dependent fields, or abstain when support remains insufficient
execute terminal validation only after all obligations close
counterfactual_checks: removing the defect must suppress the unnecessary challenge
moving the defect to another active atom must move the challenge target
moving the defect to another field dependency must move target_fields without reopening independent fields
changing defect family must change the requested check when method relevance changes
irrelevant metadata changes must not alter the recovery route
removing the fresh result must prevent the same repaired commitment
failure_examples: copy a hidden intervention label into reasoning
challenge correctly but stop without a fresh check
remeasure but ignore the resulting EvidenceAtom
repair all fields when only one interval or role is affected
